comment: No source is published. What is above comes from the maker's manual, the panel artwork and the module's own port and parameter names. The modulo range of 0.01 to 1 and the gain ceiling of 2 are fixed in the module. The module's own parameter description reads 'signal % ModuloValue (5V scaled)', which says the wrap is done on a signal scaled to five volts rather than on the raw voltage.
